top_band: thatched conical roof dome in yellow-ochre tiers, rows 2-58 (or 2-48 above the central doorway)
evidence: The thatched conical roof clearly forms the large upper top/slope surface (rows 2 to ~58 on the sides, 2 to 48 above the central door), overhanging the cylindrical mud-brick front wall below (rows 58-78). There is a distinct eave overhang with a 2-3px dark shadow band under the thatch (rows 57-60), and the central doorway is deeply recessed with an inner frame and dark interior.

style.evidence: The thatched roof has 6 distinct value steps across its lit left side and shaded right side, with detailed straw bundle texture on every tier. Outlines use dark brown/ochre material tones. The mud-brick wall below has cylindrical shading (3 value zones) plus brick mortar lines, stone base blocks, and eave shadows, matching the Beodeul building craft well.
